comment: Quiet-trace/enforcement-smoke matrix for PLAN-calibration-resource-stability. Prompt text here is generic harness text; artifacts store only its hash. The resource bands and schedule are shipped policy constants and are no longer configurable here.

workloads.prompt: Summarize, in three sentences, how a fixed measurement baseline differs from a re-anchored one when comparing repeated benchmark launches on a shared workstation.

workloads.sharedPrefix: You are a careful technical editor. The following notes describe a benchmarking protocol that compares repeated server launches against one stabilized resource baseline, with a bounded confirmation read whenever a reading looks suspicious.
suffixes: Rewrite the first note as a single sentence.
List the two independently guarded resources.
State the risk of re-anchoring in one sentence.

adaptive-1p.description: Adaptive, one profile at the calibrated production context.

adaptive-2p.description: Adaptive, two comparable profiles so cross-cell scheduling is exercised.

exact-near-capacity.description: Exact, near-capacity/full-offload combos: the highest VRAM pressure this machine can hold.

exact-lower-pressure.description: Exact, deliberately lower pressure so post-cleanup recovery is observable away from the capacity edge.
